jobs.description:

SHAPING TOMORROW

Make a real impact, today, and tomorrow, through work that matters. Here, you will tackle today’s toughest challenges with a future-focused mindset; so our clients turn to us first when it matters most.

Make a real impact

In this dynamic environment, we are looking for an ambitious and self-driven Senior Full Stack .NET Engineer
to join our AI Software Engineering team
.

Assist in the creation of the system design and functional specifications
Drafting technical specifications for the several stages of the implementation project
Design, implementation, testing and documentation of enterprise level tailor made multi-tier applications
Implement integration with third party applications / data sources
Utilise various workflow, document management, content management, portal systems / frameworks
Active contribution in business development activities, participating in meetings/presentations with clients, participating in the RFP process, preparing the necessary documentation

What You Bring Matters

At least four (4) years of relevant professional experience in Software Development using .NET technologies
Bachelor or Master degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Sciences or related discipline
Excellent programming skills in Object-oriented development and experience in .NET an/or .NET Core and related frameworks

In-depth knowledge of Databases and SQL (mainly MS SQL Server and/or Oracle DB, MySQL)

Proven experience in Scrum Methodology
Ability to use modeling languages (e.g. UML) for data modeling, design of business workflows and other types of diagrams
Strong understanding of Multithreaded applications and High Performance web applications
Sound knowledge of automated unit/integration testing processes and related frameworks (e.g. nUnit, xUnit, Specflow, Selenium or other)
Any technical knowledge of Cloud environments and architecture (Azure or AWS) is considered a plus.
Any experience with React, Angular 2+, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, CSS is considered a plus

BRING YOUR BEST, EVERYDAY

Your skills, integrity, and curiosity make the difference. At PwC Greece, we match that with an environment that brings out your best every day – supported by people who inspire, challenge, and grow with you.

Your work life-balance supported by a hybrid working model
Your creativity sparked in collaborative office spaces
Your career growing through local and global opportunities

Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? At PwC Greece, you lead by example. Our standards for quality and care are high – and together we surpass them. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

Benefits & Perks 🎁

Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).
Flexible working hours.
Health and life insurance program.
Learning & development budget.
Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!
We’d love to hear from you!

All applications will be treated with confidentiality. Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

As part of our commitment to diversity in the workforce, Infiterra is dedicated to Equal Employment Opportunity, ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and consideration without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.title: Responsable de projets applicatifs .NET/Angular (Freelance possible)
jobs.description:
Tâches et responsabilités

Chef de projet IT

Vous encadrez des équipes techniques, coordonnez les parties prenantes et pilotez des projets selon la méthodologie Agile Scrum. Cela comprend la planification, la gestion des priorités, l’animation des cérémonies Scrum et le reporting régulier. Selon votre profil, vous intervenez également comme référent technique auprès des équipes. La fonction combine donc des dimensions managériales et techniques, avec l’appui d’un comité de pilotage pour les décisions clés.

Au cours des 4 à 6 premiers mois, vous prenez principalement en charge la maintenance et la migration de fonctionnalités d’une application legacy de type client lourd Windows, utilisée pour la gestion d’enquêtes et la rédaction de procès-verbaux. En parallèle, vous soutenez le lancement d’un nouveau projet de plateforme web moderne de type Case Management System, destiné à répondre à un besoin opérationnel critique dans le cadre de la coopération policière internationale.

La nouvelle solution repose sur une architecture moderne basée sur des microservices, des micro frontends Angular, la conteneurisation, la haute disponibilité et la scalabilité. Une fois la migration terminée, votre focus se portera principalement sur ce nouveau projet, tout en conservant un suivi plus limité de la maintenance et du support de l’application legacy jusqu’à son remplacement complet.

Pour chacun des projets, vous définissez les délais, organisez les priorités et veillez à l’atteinte des objectifs, sous la supervision d’un Program Manager responsable de l’ensemble.

Missions principales

Prendre connaissance de l’existant et proposer des pistes techniques pour stabiliser certaines parties de l’application legacy.
Veiller à la compatibilité de l’application legacy avec les futures versions de Windows et à sa stabilité en exécution.
Superviser les développements backend et frontend, ainsi que la mise en place des tests unitaires et d’intégration.
Encadrer le développement d’une application web SPA responsive selon une architecture micro-frontend.
Veiller à une bonne gestion du code source avec Git, GitLab, branches, pull requests et code reviews.
S’assurer de la rédaction de la documentation technique par les équipes.
Piloter les aspects DevOps, y compris la mise en place des pipelines CI/CD pour les applications, les services et l’infrastructure, notamment dans des environnements Kubernetes et IaC.
Suivre les priorités, ajuster le planning si nécessaire et communiquer régulièrement l’état d’avancement au comité de pilotage.
Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions sécurisées by design, y compris sur les volets authentification et intégration.
Accompagner la modélisation fonctionnelle et technique via UML et BPMN, ainsi que le suivi du monitoring avec des outils tels que Grafana.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire au minimum d’un bachelier en informatique, idéalement complété par un master, et vous justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience en développement logiciel, y compris dans des rôles techniques, ainsi que dans une fonction similaire.

Vous combinez leadership, capacité de coordination et crédibilité technique. Vous savez fédérer des interlocuteurs variés, construire rapidement un réseau de collaboration, faire preuve d’empathie et adopter la fermeté nécessaire lorsque la situation l’exige. Vous adaptez votre style de management aux profils de l’équipe et savez évaluer les compétences afin d’attribuer les bonnes tâches aux bonnes personnes.

Vous gérez efficacement les priorités, savez faire évoluer les plans en cas d’imprévus et travaillez avec une forte orientation résultats. Les cérémonies Scrum telles que Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Review et Rétrospective font partie de votre pratique quotidienne.

Sur le plan technique, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en .NET (C#), appliquées notamment à des architectures microservices. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les API REST ou gRPC, les approches event-driven, ainsi qu’avec le développement d’applications web de type SPA en Angular, HTML et CSS selon une architecture micro-frontend.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes d’authentification via OpenID Connect et O365, tant pour les services backend que pour les applications frontend. Vous avez également une expérience confirmée en CI/CD et en mise en place de pipelines de déploiement avec GitLab. Vous maîtrisez Git et êtes familier des concepts de branches, pull requests et revues de code.

Vous avez de bonnes bases en bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL. Une expérience en Infrastructure as Code constitue une plus-value importante, tout comme des connaissances en cryptographie, en Delphi ou en outils de monitoring tels que Grafana ou Prometheus.

La maîtrise de l’anglais ainsi que d’une des deux langues nationales est requise. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre représente un atout supplémentaire. Une connaissance du fonctionnement des services de police constitue également un avantage.

Soft Skills

Capacité à fédérer des profils hétérogènes autour d’un objectif commun
Persévérance face aux difficultés majeures
Capacité à temporiser et à maintenir un climat constructif sous pression
Esprit d’initiative et proactivité
Sens des priorités et vision à long terme
Orientation utilisateur et sens du terrain
Communication claire, fluide et adaptée à différents publics
Vision transverse intégrant les dimensions techniques, humaines, organisationnelles et politiques
Esprit analytique et capacité à identifier les causes profondes des problèmes

Hard Skills

Gestion de projet complexe en environnement Agile, avec une maîtrise particulière de Scrum
Modernisation d’applications et transition d’un client lourd vers une solution web moderne
Conception sécurisée et sécurité by design
Modélisation logicielle avec UML et BPMN
Monitoring avec Grafana ou Prometheus
Architecture microservices, microfrontend (Angular) et event-driven
Développement en .NET (C#), Angular, HTML et CSS
Tests unitaires et d’intégration
Bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL
DevOps avec GitLab, CI/CD, Kubernetes et IaC
Authentification via OpenID et O365

Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.title: Back-End Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

Fincons is looking for a Back-End Software Engineer – Advanced

TASKS:

Develop and maintain back-end applications, services, and business logic, ensuring clean, scalable, and high-quality code.
Design, build, secure, and optimize APIs, data storage solutions, and cloud-based back-end services.
Implement security best practices, including authentication, authorization, input validation, secure logging, and monitoring.
Perform testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization, leveraging monitoring and observability tools.
Contribute to the design and delivery of scalable software solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.
Maintain technical documentation, code integrity, and CI/CD-integrated testing practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

10+ years of experience in software development, with strong expertise in Java, Spring Framework, and REST API development.
Strong back-end development experience with Java, PHP, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and Node.js, combined with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
Expertise in APM, monitoring, and observability tools (Dynatrace, Splunk, Elastic APM, OpenTelemetry), as well as relational and NoSQL databases.
Proven experience in designing and securing REST APIs, event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka, and supporting Case Management solutions.
Hands-on knowledge of Git-based development workflows, Docker, Kubernetes, and Agile development methodologies.
Good understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT).
Professional experience in competition policy environments.

CERTIFICATES:

(Optional) One of the following or an equivalent certification:

AWS Certified Developer Associate, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, or CNCF Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).

SKILLS:

Talent for attention to detail in code correctness, error handling, and documentation.
Ability to analyze complex back-end issues and design effective solutions.
Capability of integration in an international/multi-cultural environment.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.

Language knowledge:
English B2+

Office:
Brussels (Belgium), far-site service provision with possible onsite presence as deemed necessary during the execution of specific contract.

Minimum level of qualification:
Master’s degree and 10 years of experience or 17 years of experience.

If interested, please apply!

Our personnel search is addressed to candidates of all genders.
